annotation.title_clean: Leitlinien zu Transparenzverpflichtungen für Anbieter und Betreiber von KI-Systemen
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of AI systems
named_instruments_referenced: Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
annotation.summary_en: European Commission landing page (German version) for its July 2026 Guidelines on the transparency obligations that Article 50 of the AI Act places on providers and deployers of AI systems. These obligations apply from 2 August 2026. The page links to the guidelines PDF, a FAQ, a fact page and the Code of Practice on AI-generated content. The page has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: The AI Act takes a risk-based approach with four risk categories, one of which covers systems that pose transparency risks
Article 50 transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026
The Commission adopted the guidelines to help authorities, providers and deployers comply in a consistent and proportionate way
Links to a Code of Practice on transparency of AI-generated content
